title: 安田記念の後に・燃える戦場へ

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: First place goes to Hishi Amazon! She takes the win, staying true to her promise!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon was awesome! I wonder where we'll see her next?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I hope she'll turn up at the Japan Cup or the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: And if Narita Brian makes an appearance, we can count on a great race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeeeah! Did you see that, Teach?! I won!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I won first place, just like I promised. This victory should help build up my reputation a bit more, eh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The only race left is my one-on-one at the Arima Kinen…
Hishi Amazon looks like she has something on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I've been thinking… Before we take on the Arima Kinen, could we have a go at another big race first?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I only ran the Osaka Hai and the Yasuda Kinen in order to prep for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The idea was for me to beef up in time for the big race, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But you know what? I had so much fun out there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The competition was super intense! It was electrifying!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I feel like another tough battle like that would make me even stronger, and…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Why am I beating around the bush? What I'm trying to say is—I want to run in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I want to experience another real excitin' one-on-one!
Hishi Amazon is already buzzing with excitement just thinking about the thrilling battle ahead.
And I see no reason to slow her roll.
choice_data_list: Of course you can run it!

text_block_list.text: We set our sights on the Japan Cup, where only the best of the best gather to race!
